text: Task IO — Design a Segmentation System for an Unknown Image You have joined a computer-vision development team. Your team receives an image but is not told which segmentation method should be used. Your task is to act as the segmentation engineer. Choose an image containing a reasonably challenging segmentation problem. Examples include: • unevenly illuminated document • colored object touching objects • grayscale object/ background • complex natural scene You may use one of the images from the previous tasks. Your Task Implement three different segmentation approaches: You must choose from: • • • Global thresholding Adaptive thresholding Otsu's thresholding Color-based thresholding Canny edge detection Region growing Watershed K-Means Additional Requirement Do not simply run the methods and display their outputs. For every selected method, identify: 1. What assumption the method makes about the image 2. What region/object it successfully identifies Talha Shahid 10 | Page
